title: Restore CommandCenterUI local-model security hardening reverted by the untracked 2026-07-21 edit
description: The untracked 2026-07-21 edit to /home/mellow/Projects/CommandCenterUI/app/server.py (see artifacts/audits/task254-untracked-edit-2026-07-21.md) was built from a stale base and silently reverted three local-model security controls that the template still carries. Restore all three in the live file WITHOUT discarding the genuine feature work the same edit introduced. 1) ollama_models() lost the loopback env pin, so Ollama discovery now inherits an ambient remote OLLAMA_HOST. 2) SUMMARY_MODEL default flipped from None to gemma3:4b, enabling the background summarizer by default. 3) The SUMMARY_MODEL is-None guards on the worker-thread start and on enqueue() were deleted, so the summarizer runs even when no model is configured. Combined effect: agent message content is auto-summarised by a local model and, with the loopback pin gone, could be sent to a remote Ollama host. The running process still holds the old hardened constants in memory; a restart picks up the regression.
acceptance_criteria: ollama_models() pins env OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1:11434 for the ollama list subprocess, matching the template rationale that discovery and launch must use the same loopback-only endpoint.
SUMMARY_MODEL defaults to None so the background summarizer is opt-in; enabling it requires an explicit COMMAND_CENTER_UI_SUMMARY_MODEL value.
The SUMMARY_MODEL is-None guards are restored on both the worker-thread start and enqueue(), so SUMMARY_MODEL=None genuinely disables the summarizer rather than only unsetting a label.
Feature work from the same edit is preserved, specifically the quoted-summary extraction in the summary post-processing; python3 -m py_compile passes on the live file.
